Game Overview

At its heart, Penguin Skip is a skill game about join Penguin Spok on an icy adventure as he leaps between frosty platforms to avoid chilly waters below. Master the art of deft jumps while collecting fish for points and discovering fun outfits, creating endless character customization possibilities. Fast reactions and strategic jumps are your keys to success!
